gates.reason: 'Verify is a report, not a blocker — it exits 0 even when criteria fail' is a NEGATIVE gate (an absence of failure), and asserting it needs a live plan + a running app the verify runner drives via Playwright to produce a genuine criterion failure at exit 0 — not hermetically constructible under the cli-exit fixture without a browser. The strict-selectors FAILURE direction is bound executably above.

The PLAN_SATISFIED / PLAN_PARTIAL / PLAN_NOT_SHIPPED status rubric is computed by the verify runner over live plan_satisfaction data (a browser-driven run against a real app); it surfaces as a status string, not a process exit code the cli-exit oracle can assert.
